angiogenx.intro: AngiogenX supports the health of the small blood vessels in your eyes. It combines pine bark OPCs, trans-resveratrol, curcumin, notoginseng and crocin from gardenia fruit.
angiogenx.how_it_works:
The retina depends on a dense network of very small blood vessels. Here is what each ingredient in AngiogenX does.

In human eye studies, a pine bark extract helped small blood vessels keep fluid inside. One study used 150 mg of that extract a day.

In animal studies, resveratrol helped regulate the signals that drive new blood vessel growth. After oral doses, it and its breakdown products have been found in human eye tissue.

In an animal study, curcumin helped calm inflammatory signals in the retina.

In an animal study, notoginseng saponins helped keep the barrier between blood and retina intact.

Crocin is a pigment found in gardenia fruit. It supports the retina. Two human eye trials used 15 mg a day, the amount in one capsule.

vitamin-d-syntropy.description:
Vitamin D is formed in the skin when sunlight transforms cholesterol made by enzymatic activity in the liver. Vitamin D is not only the vitamin of light, it is also a hormone, like the other hormones the body makes from cholesterol as a precursor. Vitamin D is crucial for many functions including calcium metabolism, immunity and nerve function. Individuals who take more than 2,000 IU per day of vitamin D should have their vitamin D levels monitored.

Each capsule pairs 5000 IU of D3 with 180 mcg of vitamin K2 as MK-7, vitamin A, vitamin C, vitamin E, boron, iodine, magnesium as L-threonate and selenium. Three botanicals round it out: Butea, Eucommia and xanthohumol from hops. The capsule is Certified Organic Pullulan, with no fillers or excipients.

Take 1 capsule daily with a meal, or as guided.

Caution: If you take a blood thinner such as warfarin, consult your physician before use, because vitamin K affects it. Consult your physician before use if you are pregnant or have a thyroid condition. Consult your physician first if you have high blood calcium, kidney stones or kidney disease, or take thiazide diuretics or digoxin. It is not for children, or for use while breastfeeding.

clarity.intro:
Clarity supports both your eyes and your brain.

Your retina develops from the same tissue as your brain.

So your retina and your brain share many of the same needs.

Rosmarinic acid, concentrated from rosemary, is the heart of Clarity.

In a laboratory study, it supported the clarity of human lens protein.

That study inspired this formula.

Pterostilbene is a natural polyphenol found in blueberries, and a close relative of resveratrol.

In studies of aging animals, it supported memory and healthy brain function.

In cell and animal studies, it also protected delicate eye tissues.

A small amount of piperine, from black pepper, is included.

vitreous-vitality.description:
Vitreous Vitality is an Energetically Correct™ Functional Formulation designed to support the health and structural integrity of the vitreous body, the clear gel-like tissue that fills the back of your eye and helps it maintain its shape. This formulation works with your body's natural systems to promote resilience in the connective tissues of the eye while helping defend against everyday oxidative stress.

The formula brings together three complementary layers of support. Antioxidant botanicals including grape seed proanthocyanidins, trans-resveratrol, luteolin, crocin, and black goji help protect against free radical damage. Structural building blocks like high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid, L-lysine, and rice ceramides provide the raw materials your body needs to maintain connective tissue integrity. Targeted minerals including zinc, manganese, chromium, and magnesium, along with taurine, work synergistically to support the tissues that keep your eye functioning optimally. The formula contains no fillers or preservatives, only what your eye health needs.

Vitreous Vitality is for anyone looking to proactively support their eye health and maintain clear vision as they age. Whether you want to support vitreous structure or give your eyes comprehensive nutritional support, this formulation provides clinically selected nutrients in the specific forms and amounts your body can use most effectively.
vitreous-vitality.intro: Vitreous Vitality combines nutrients that support the structural and functional integrity of your eyes, from the retina to the lens to the vitreous fluid itself. Retinyl acetate, zinc carnosine and crocin work together to help maintain visual clarity and comfort, while magnesium threonate and taurine support the neural pathways that let you see and process what you're looking at. The formula also includes proteolytic enzymes and compounds like hyaluronic acid and rice ceramides that help maintain tissue hydration and flexibility, which matters because your eyes need fluidity and elasticity to function well. This is the kind of targeted, multi-system support your vision deserves as you age.
vitreous-vitality.directions: 1 capsule daily with food, as guided.
vitreous-vitality.warning: Each capsule supplies 8,520 mcg RAE (28,400 IU) of preformed vitamin A. That is nearly 3 times the adult daily upper limit of 3,000 mcg RAE (10,000 IU). The limit counts preformed vitamin A from food and supplements together. The jar label says retinyl palmitate 2,500 IU and up to 3 capsules a day. That label is wrong for this batch. Follow this page instead. Take no more than 1 capsule a day, and only as guided by your health professional. Do not take it for longer than 6 months unless your health professional advises it. Do not add other sources of preformed vitamin A. These include multivitamins, cod liver oil, liver and other formulas that list vitamin A, including our own. Do not use with retinoid medicines such as isotretinoin or acitretin. Do not use with tetracycline antibiotics such as doxycycline or minocycline. Do not use if you are pregnant, may become pregnant or are breastfeeding. Do not give it to anyone under 18. Stop and seek advice if you notice headache, blurred vision, nausea, dizziness, bone or joint pain, or dry, peeling skin. Do not use if you have Stargardt disease or another ABCA4 retinal condition. Do not use if you are allergic to pineapple. Consult your health professional before use if you have liver or kidney disease or drink alcohol daily. Consult your health professional before long-term use if you have osteoporosis or low bone density. Also consult first if you take any medicine, especially blood-thinning or blood-sugar medicines. This includes aspirin and ibuprofen. Consult first too if you have a bleeding disorder, or before planned surgery. Keep out of reach of children.
